descriptors.name: ot-ncp-ftd-ble-rcp
descriptors.label: Multiprotocol (OpenThread+BLE) - NCP
descriptors.description: This multiprotocol Network Co-Processor (NCP) application enables concurrent OpenThread (Full Thread Device) and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connectivity. The OpenThread stack runs on the co-processor (NCP), while BLE operates as a controller, with its host stack running on the main processor. This architecture leverages Silicon Labs multiprotocol capabilities for seamless mesh networking (Thread) and point-to-point wireless communication (BLE). Communication between host and NCP uses the Co-Processor Communication protocol (CPC), acting as a protocol multiplexer and serial transport layer. Host applications connect to the CPC daemon, which in turn connects to the EFR device via UART or EUSART. Refer to *docs.silabs.com Multiprotocol section - Multiprotocol on Linux Solution: Running Thread and Bluetooth Concurrently on a Linux Host with a Multiprotocol Network Co-Processor* for more information on host/co-processor integration and multiprotocol use cases.

descriptors.name: rcp-spi-802154-blehci
descriptors.label: Multiprotocol (OpenThread+Zigbee+BLE) - RCP (SPI)
descriptors.description: This multiprotocol radio co-processor (RCP) application supports running OpenThread, Zigbee, and Bluetooth stacks simultaneously on a host processor. It uses concurrent multiprotocol (CMP) / multi-PAN functionality to run the 802.15.4 networks simultaneously on the same channel, and dynamic multiprotocol (DMP) to run the Bluetooth Link Layer simultaneously. The host stacks and the RCP communicate using the Co-Processor Communication protocol (CPC), which acts as a protocol multiplexer and serial transport layer. The host applications connect to the CPC daemon, which in turn connects to the EFR via a SPI link. Refer to *docs.silabs.com Multiprotocol section- Multiprotocol on Linux Solution: Running Zigbee, OpenThread, and Bluetooth Concurrently on a Linux Host with a Multiprotocol Co-processor* for more information on running the multiprotocol RCP with different host applications.

descriptors.name: zigbee_ncp_ot_rcp_uart_gp_multi_rail
descriptors.label: Zigbee - Zigbee NCP + OpenThread RCP + GP multi RAIL over UART link
descriptors.description: This network co-processor (NCP) application supports concurrent multiprotocol (CMP) operation, running the Zigbee NCP alongside the OpenThread RCP. Communication with host applications is enabled using the Co-Processor Communication Protocol (CPC), which acts as a protocol multiplexer and serial transport layer. Host applications connect to the CPC daemon, which interfaces with the EFR via a UART link. The application integrates the multiple RAIL demo component (multirail-demo), enabling the use of a second RAIL handle to schedule pre-configured outgoing Green Power device frames (GPDF) in response to incoming bidirectional GPDFs with the rx-after-tx bit set. The Zigbee NCP can be built as configured or optionally extended with custom initialization, main loop processing, event handling, and host messaging features.
